sources.snippet: Note on the base architecture: Qwen3.8-27B is a new hybrid/multimodal model (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, internal arch tag qwen35, with linear-attention/mamba and MTP layers). This affected both LoRA→GGUF conversion and adapter loading — see Usage → GGUF below for the one extra step needed.
